text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock E after a large gain, then bought it back at a higher price; I should base trades on current prospects, not on locking in gains or chasing prices.","A losing position can tempt me to hold just to avoid admitting a mistake; I should reassess it as objectively as any other investment.","Several down months are not proof that prices will keep falling, just as earlier gains did not predict more gains; I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and keep risk aligned with my plan."]}
